symptoms: Rh-negative non-sensitised women following surgical management of miscarriage

management_steps.details: IM, 50 mcg preferably within 72 hours but may be given up to 7 days following management of miscarriage.
Indicated for Rh-negative non-sensitised women who had a surgical procedure to manage a miscarriage.

warnings: Do not offer Anti-D prophylaxis to women who only received medical management for a miscarriage, had a threatened miscarriage, or had a complete miscarriage.
